No. HCMEST-43/14/2024-ESTT-1SECTION-HCM/ The following
persons are hereby engaged as Skilled Daily Wagers (Sewage Treatment Plant –
Operators) on Daily Wage Basis @ ?480/- (Rupees four hundred and eighty) only per
day w.e.f. the date of joining and until further orders. They shall not claim for
regularization of their service on this purely temporary engagement.
